title: Circular Couette flow with swirl (exact; centrifugal force balanced by the pressure; rho = 5/4)
physics: u = (0, A r + B / r, 0) between r1 = 1/2 (Omega_1 = 2) and r2 = 1 (at rest), cut at z = 0, 1/2 with the exact data; p = rho int u_theta^2 / r dr; rho = 5/4, mu = 1/32

convective_form_definitions.standard: c(w; u, v) = rho ((w. grad) u, v)
convective_form_definitions.skew: c(w; u, v) = rho ((w. grad) u, v) + (rho/2) ((div w) u, v) (Temam; natural BC unchanged: a traction BC prescribes sigma_form n = g for both forms)

parameters.quadrature_requirement: The convective trilinear form and every load integral must be integrated EXACTLY for the polynomial integrands of P2 on affine triangles: degree >= 5 planar (P2. grad P2. P2), degree >= 6 in axisymmetry (the extra factor r); the viscous form with variable mu by a rule of degree >= 4 planar (as F1a) and, in AXISYMMETRY, the r-weighted viscous form (with its rational hoop terms mu u_r v_r / r, mu u_theta v_theta / r) by a rule of degree >= 6 (with degree 4 a correct code's energy-identity defect reaches 9.1e-10, with degree 6 <= 2.4e-11). The discrete energy identities (cons_ns_energy_identity) and the cross-code values (xcode_cavity_re1000) assume it.

nonlinear_solver.start: the TRUE Stokes solution with the Dirichlet data (the convective term absent from both the matrix and the residual of that first step: Oseen with zero advecting velocity), then n_picard = 3 Picard (Oseen) steps, then Newton with an Armijo backtracking line search on the DUAL-norm merit ||R||_* (sufficient decrease 1e-4; lambda = 1, 1/2,..., 1/64; lambda = 1/64 is accepted even without sufficient decrease and then counts as a violation in the line-search check)
nonlinear_solver.residual_definition: relative_residual = ||R(x)||_* / ||R(x_lift)||_*, the discrete dual norm over the rows of the system actually solved (a pinned pressure row excluded), with consistent exactly integrated mass matrices, and x_lift the P2 Lagrange NODAL lift (the Dirichlet data at the boundary nodes, vertices and edge midpoints, ZERO at every other node, p = 0): with that definite lift the same number in every basis of the same spaces (zeroing the interior coefficients of a hierarchical basis gives another lift and a denominator smaller by 1.8-1.9)
nonlinear_solver.history: every run reports solver.history = [{kind: stokes|picard|newton|ptc, residual, step, dt}] with the relative residual after each step

parameters.shared_node_rule: At a velocity node shared by several boundary attributes: (1) Dirichlet beats every natural condition (traction); (2) between Dirichlet attributes the fixed data AGREE at shared nodes (one exact callable per field; checked by dirichlet_shared_node_mismatch_max), so the result is independent of attribute order; (3) AXISYMMETRIC: at a node on the axis r = 0 the axis condition u_r = u_theta = 0 holds and beats the data (the exact data have the same limit; the numpy spelling of the data is not evaluated at r = 0 for u_r, u_theta); u_z takes the data.
parameters.dirichlet_data: P2 Lagrange NODAL interpolation of the fixed callables (vertices and edge midpoints)

couette_rect.construction: f2a_ns_check.rect_mesh(4, 4, k, 1/2, 1, 0, 1/2) in (r, z): 4 x 4 squares of side 1/8, TH corner cells flipped, red-refined k times. Nested.

boundaries.r = 1/2, r = 1, z = 0, z = 1/2: Dirichlet from the exact solution (u_r = u_z = 0, u_theta = A r + B / r)
